{{External|rs|rsc=Mithril_Chain_Mail_Body}} {{Infobox Item |name = Mithril chainbody |image = [[File:Mithril chainbody.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = A series of connected metal rings. |value = 1950 |weight = 5.896 |exchange = Yes |id = 1109 }} [[File:Mithril chainbody detail.png|120px|left]] The '''Mithril chainbody''' is a [[chainbody]] made out of [[mithril equipment|mithril]]. As with all mithril armour, it requires 20 [[Defence]] to wear. Like all chainbodies, it provides better Crush defence than a [[Mithril platebody|platebody]] made of the same material, at the cost of lower Stab and Slash defence. The Mithril chainbody can be made with level 61 [[Smithing]] using 3 [[mithril bar]]s, and grants 150 Smithing experience. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -15 |arange = 0 |dstab = +25 |dslash = +35 |dcrush = +42 |dmagic = -3 |drange = +27 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = body |image = [[File:Mithril chainbody equipped male.png|130px]] |altimage = [[File:Mithril chainbody equipped female.png|150px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 61 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 150 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Mithril bar |mat1quantity = 3 |output1 = Mithril chainbody }} ==Treasure Trails== {{EmoteClue}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Mithril chainbody}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Mithril chainbody}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 10 April 2006 |update = Rag and Bone Man |change = *The item was graphically updated. *The item's equip model was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 17 – 24 November 2004 |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Mithril chainbody detail (historical, v1).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Mithril chainbody detail (historical, v2).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Mithril chainbody detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Mithril chainbody (historical, v1).png|center]] |[[File:Mithril chainbody (historical, v2).png|center]] |[[File:Mithril chainbody.png|center]] |- |[[File:Mithril chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Mithril chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Mithril chainbody equipped male.png|center|300x300px]] |- |29 March 2004 –
